### bar plot for ALL ion adducts
2 plots in one 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)

# --- color palette ---
make_rank_palette <- function(n) {
  hues <- seq(15, 375, length.out = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}

# --- cut point ---
get_cut_info <- function(df_lib) {
  max_n <- max(df_lib$n)
  if (max_n > 3000) return(list(cut = 700, factor = 25))
  if (max_n > 1000) return(list(cut = 200, factor = 15))
  if (max_n > 200)  return(list(cut = 50,  factor = 10))
  return(NULL)
}

# ---  BAR + PIE with axis break ---
plot_ion_dist_duo <- function(df, lib_name, pie_label_min_pct = 1) {
  # Aggregate data
  df_lib <- df %>%
    filter(Library == lib_name) %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      prop = 100 * n / sum(n),
      Category = fct_reorder(Category, n)
    )

  rank_palette <- make_rank_palette(nrow(df_lib))

  # Detect cut (fake break)
  cut_info <- get_cut_info(df_lib)

  if (!is.null(cut_info)) {
    cut_val <- cut_info$cut
    comp <- cut_info$factor
    df_lib <- df_lib %>%
      mutate(
        n_adj = ifelse(n > cut_val,
                       cut_val + (n - cut_val) / comp,
                       n)
      )
  } else {
    df_lib <- df_lib %>% mutate(n_adj = n)
  }

  # === BAR plot ===
  p_bar <- ggplot(df_lib, aes(x = n_adj, y = Category, fill = factor(rank))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = n_adj + 0.03 * max(n_adj),
          label = paste0(n, " (", sprintf("%.2f", prop), "%)")),
      hjust = 0, size = 3.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Ion adduct distribution —", lib_name),
      x = "Number of peaks (compressed scale)",
      y = "Ion form"
    )

  # Adjust axis ticks
  if (!is.null(cut_info)) {
    p_bar <- p_bar +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = c(
          seq(0, cut_info$cut, length.out = 6),
          max(df_lib$n_adj)
        ),
        labels = c(
          as.character(round(seq(0, cut_info$cut, length.out = 6))),
          as.character(max(df_lib$n))
        )
      )
  }

  # === PIE plot ===
  df_pie <- df_lib %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      ypos = cumsum(n) - 0.5 * n,
      label = ifelse(prop >= pie_label_min_pct,
                     paste0(Category, " (", sprintf("%.2f", prop), "%)"),
                     "")
    )

  p_pie <- ggplot(df_pie, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = factor(rank))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    labs(title = paste("Adduct composition —", lib_name)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5))

  # Combine side by side
  p_bar + p_pie + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(2, 1))
}


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)

# --- Dynamic color palette ---
make_rank_palette <- function(n) {
  hues <- seq(15, 375, length.out = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}

# --- Main plotting function (now accepts cut_info) ---
plot_ion_dist_duo <- function(df, lib_name,
                              cut_info = NULL,
                              pie_label_min_pct = 1) {

  # --- Default compression values ---
  if (is.null(cut_info)) {
    cut_info <- switch(
      lib_name,
      "In-house" = list(cut = 800, factor = 25),
      "MoNA"     = list(cut = 750, factor = 20),
      "CSU-PMF"  = list(cut = 750, factor = 30),
      list(cut = 500, factor = 20) # fallback
    )
  }

  # --- Aggregate data ---
  df_lib <- df %>%
    filter(Library == lib_name) %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      prop = 100 * n / sum(n),
      Category = fct_reorder(Category, n)
    )

  # --- Apply compression  ---
  df_lib <- df_lib %>%
    mutate(
      n_adj = ifelse(n > cut_info$cut,
                     cut_info$cut + (n - cut_info$cut) / cut_info$factor,
                     n)
    )

  # --- Shared color palette ---
  rank_palette <- make_rank_palette(nrow(df_lib))

  # === BAR plot ===
  p_bar <- ggplot(df_lib, aes(x = n_adj, y = Category, fill = factor(rank))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = n_adj + 0.03 * max(n_adj),
          label = paste0(n, " (", sprintf("%.2f", prop), "%)")),
      hjust = 0, size = 5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(seq(0, cut_info$cut, length.out = 6), max(df_lib$n_adj)),
      labels = c(as.character(round(seq(0, cut_info$cut, length.out = 6))),
                 as.character(max(df_lib$n)))
    ) +
    expand_limits(x = max(df_lib$n_adj) * 1.1) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
     # plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.line.x = element_line()
    ) +
    labs(
  #    title = paste("Ion species distribution —", lib_name),
      x = "Number of peaks",
      y = "Ion form"
    )

  # === PIE plot ===
  df_pie <- df_lib %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      ypos = cumsum(n) - 0.5 * n,
      label = ifelse(prop >= pie_label_min_pct,
                     paste0(Category, " (", sprintf("%.2f", prop), "%)"),
                     "")
    )

  p_pie <- ggplot(df_pie, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = factor(rank))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    #labs(title = paste("Adduct composition —", lib_name)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5))

  # return both plots
  list(
    bar_plot = p_bar,
    pie_plot = p_pie
  )
}

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)

# --- Dynamic color palette ---
make_rank_palette <- function(n) {
  hues <- seq(15, 375, length.out = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}

# --- Main plotting function (simulated break, returns list) ---
plot_ion_dist_duo <- function(df, lib_name, pie_label_min_pct = 1) {

  # --- Hard-coded compression per library (simulated break) ---
  cut_info <- switch(
    lib_name,
    "In-house" = list(cut = 800, factor = 25),
    "MoNA"     = list(cut = 750, factor = 20),
    "CSU-PMF"  = list(cut = 750, factor = 30),
    list(cut = 500, factor = 20) # fallback
  )

  # --- Aggregate data ---
  df_lib <- df %>%
    filter(Library == lib_name) %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      prop = 100 * n / sum(n),
      Category = fct_reorder(Category, n)
    )

  # --- Apply compression (fake break) ---
  df_lib <- df_lib %>%
    mutate(
      n_adj = ifelse(n > cut_info$cut,
                     cut_info$cut + (n - cut_info$cut) / cut_info$factor,
                     n)
    )

  # --- Shared color palette ---
  rank_palette <- make_rank_palette(nrow(df_lib))

  # === BAR plot ===
  p_bar <- ggplot(df_lib, aes(x = n_adj, y = Category, fill = factor(rank))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = n_adj + 0.03 * max(n_adj),
          label = paste0(n, " (", sprintf("%.2f", prop), "%)")),
      hjust = 0, size = 5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(
        seq(0, cut_info$cut, length.out = 6),
        max(df_lib$n_adj)
      ),
      labels = c(
        as.character(round(seq(0, cut_info$cut, length.out = 6))),
        as.character(max(df_lib$n))
      )
    ) +
    expand_limits(x = max(df_lib$n_adj) * 1.1) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      #plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.line.x = element_line()
    ) +
    labs(
      #title = paste("Ion adduct distribution —", lib_name),
      x = "Number of peaks",
      y = "Ion form"
    )

  # === PIE plot ===
  df_pie <- df_lib %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      ypos = cumsum(n) - 0.5 * n,
      label = ifelse(prop >= pie_label_min_pct,
                     paste0(Category, " (", sprintf("%.2f", prop), "%)"),
                     "")
    )

  p_pie <- ggplot(df_pie, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = factor(rank))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    # labs(title = paste("Adduct composition —", lib_name)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5))

  # eturn both plots separately
  list(
    bar_plot = p_bar,
    pie_plot = p_pie
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Load adduct and neutral loss tables
adduct_table <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "Adducts", "adducts.csv", package = "MS1Match"))

adduct_table
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)

# Combine and count
combined <- bind_rows(df_inhouse, df_mona, df_csu) %>%
  count(Library, Category)




# Ion order exactly as in the paper (no Anions)
ion_order <- c(
  "[M+H]+", "[M+Na]+", "[M+NH4]+", "[M+K]+",
  "[M-H2O+H]+", "[M]+", "[M+2H]2+",
 "[2M+H]+", "Other smaller m/z", "Other larger m/z"
)

# Ensure all categories exist in every library (fill zeros)
combined <- combined %>%
  complete(Library, Category = ion_order, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = rev(ion_order)))

# Colors from the paper (no anion color)
ion_colors <- c(
  "[M+H]+" = "#9e0059",
  "[M+Na]+" = "#6da7de",
  "[M+NH4]+" = "#dee000",
  "[M+K]+" = "#d82222",
  "[M-H2O+H]+" = "#63c5b5",
  "[M]+" = "#ff38ba",
  "[M+2H]2+" = "#eb861e",
  "[2M+H]+" = "#ee266d",
  "Other larger m/z" = "#868b8e",
  "Other smaller m/z" = "#5ea15d"
)

# Helper for individual plots
plot_ion_dist <- function(df, lib_name) {
  df %>%
    filter(Library == lib_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Category, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ion_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Ion adduct distribution —", lib_name),
      x = "Number of spectra",
      y = "Ion form"
    )
}

# Create 3 separate plots
p_inhouse <- plot_ion_dist(combined, "In-house")
p_mona    <- plot_ion_dist(combined, "MoNA")
p_csu     <- plot_ion_dist(combined, "CSU-PMF")

# Display them
p_inhouse
p_mona
p_csu
```

```{r}
library(ggbreak)

plot_ion_dist <- function(df, lib_name) {
  # Select dynamic x break based on library
  xbreak <- switch(lib_name,
    "In-house" = c(800, 2500),
    "MoNA"     = c(1000, 7000),
    "CSU-PMF"  = c(2000, 20000),
    c(1000, 5000) # default fallback
  )

  df %>%
    filter(Library == lib_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Category, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = ion_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_break(xbreak, scales = 0.3) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
    #  title = paste("Ion adduct distribution —", lib_name),
      x = "Number of spectra",
      y = "Ion form"
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(ggbreak)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_ion_dist_common <- function(df, lib_name) {
  # choose x-axis breakpoints dynamically
  xbreak <- switch(lib_name,
    "In-house" = c(40, 160),
    "CSU-PMF"  = c(30, 700),
    "MoNA"     = NULL,
    NULL
  )

  p <- df %>%
    filter(Library == lib_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Category, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ion_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of spectra",
      y = "Ion form"
    )

  # add break only if defined
  if (!is.null(xbreak)) {
    p <- p + scale_x_break(xbreak, scales = 0.3)
  }

  p
}

# Generate three plots
```

```{r}
summarize_and_plot_ion_forms <- function(..., normalize = TRUE, title = "Ion form distribution across libraries") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)

  # Combine all input data frames
  combined <- bind_rows(...)

  # Canonical ion categories
  ion_levels <- c(
    "[M+H]+", "[M+Na]+", "[M+NH4]+", "[M+K]+",
    "[M-H2O+H]+", "[M]+", "[M+2H]2+", "[2M+H]+",
    "Other in-source fragments", "Undefined"
  )

ion_colors <- c(
  "[M+H]+" = "#9e0059",
  "[M+Na]+" = "#6da7de",
  "[M+NH4]+" = "#dee000",
  "[M+K]+" = "#d82222",
  "[M-H2O+H]+" = "#63c5b5",
  "[M]+" = "#ff38ba",
  "[M+2H]2+" = "#eb861e",
  "[2M+H]+" = "#ee266d",
  "Other in-source fragments" = "#868b8e",
  "Undefined" = "#5ea15d"
)

  # Distinct library colors (for normalize = FALSE)
  library_colors <- c(
    "In-house" = "#2ca02c",
    "MoNA" = "#1f77b4",
    "CSU-PMF" = "#ff7f0e"
  )

  # Clean categories
  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(Category = trimws(Category),
           Category = gsub("fragment$", "fragments", Category, ignore.case = TRUE),
           Category = ifelse(Category %in% ion_levels, Category, "Undefined"),
           Category = factor(Category, levels = ion_levels))

  # Summarize
  summary_df <- combined %>%
    count(Library, Category) %>%
    complete(Library, Category = ion_levels, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    group_by(Library) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Plot
  if (normalize) {
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Library, y = prop, fill = Category)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = ion_colors, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(y = "Proportion of ion forms", x = NULL, title = title)
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Category, y = n, fill = Library)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = library_colors, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(y = "Number of MS1 peaks", x = "Ion form", title = title)
  }

  p <- p +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = if (normalize) 0 else 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )

  return(list(summary = summary_df, plot = p))
}



```

```{r}
res_full_absolute <- summarize_and_plot_ion_forms(df_inhouse, df_mona, df_csu, normalize = FALSE, title = NULL)
```

### Composition Plots


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork) # optional, to combine plots

# --- Combine and summarize ---
combined <- bind_rows(
  df_inhouse_adduct_anno,
  df_mona_adduct_anno,
  df_csu_adduct_anno
)

adduct_summary <- combined %>%
  filter(Category != "Undefined") %>%
  group_by(Library, Category) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Library) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(prop < 0.0, "Other", Category)) %>%
  group_by(Library, Category) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), prop = sum(prop), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  arrange(Library, desc(prop)) %>%
  group_by(Library) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

# --- Function to create one library palette ---
make_rank_palette <- function(n) {
  hues <- seq(15, 375, length.out = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}

# --- Shared plotting helper (generates color mapping first) ---
plot_adduct_library <- function(df, lib_name) {
  df_lib <- df %>% filter(Library == lib_name)
  rank_palette <- make_rank_palette(nrow(df_lib))
  
  # BAR plot
  p_bar <- ggplot(df_lib, aes(
    x = fct_reorder(Category, prop),
    y = prop,
    fill = factor(rank)
  )) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        n, " (",
        ifelse(
          prop < 1,
          formatC(prop, format = "f", digits = 2),  # two decimals if < 1%
          round(prop, 1)                            # otherwise one decimal
        ),
        "%)"
      )
    ),
    hjust = -0.05, size = 4, family = "sans"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13)
    ) +
    labs(
     # title = paste("Adduct composition –", lib_name),
      x = "Adduct ion species",
      y = "Percentage of total identified adducts (%)"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
  
  # PIE plot (same color scale)
  df_lib <- df_lib %>%
    arrange(desc(prop)) %>%
    mutate(
      ypos = cumsum(prop) - 0.5 * prop,
      label = ifelse(prop >= 1, paste0(Category, " (", round(prop, 2), "%)"), "")
    )
  
  p_pie <- ggplot(df_lib, aes(x = "", y = prop, fill = factor(rank))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = rank_palette, guide = "none") +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    # geom_text_repel(
    #   aes(y = ypos, label = label),
    #                #       size = 4.5,
    #                # nudge_x = 0.6,
    #                # min.segment.length = 0,
    #  size = 4.2,
    #  nudge_x = 1,
    # # direction = "y",
    #  segment.size = 0.3,
    #  segment.alpha = 0.3,
    #   show.legend = FALSE
    # ) +
   # labs(title = paste("Adduct composition –", lib_name)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5))
  
  # Combine side by side (optional)
  combined_plot <- p_bar + p_pie + plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1))
  return(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_main_ions_ranked <- function(data, lib_name) {
  df <- data %>%
    filter(Library == lib_name) %>%
    arrange(desc(prop)) %>%
    mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = rev(Category)))  # reverse levels for coord_flip()
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Category, y = prop, fill = reorder(Category, prop))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired", direction = -1) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(lib_name, " — Main ion species"),
      x = "Ion form (ranked by proportion)",
      y = "Proportion of ion forms"
    )
}
```
